title: Vector cohesive kinematics, mixed-mode energy and model rank
purpose: Verify complete interface jump/traction kinematics, damage-compatible shear transfer, mixed-mode energy interactions, compression contact, algorithmic tangents, rigid-mode preflight, physical-facet restart and post-peak continuation plumbing.
physics: Two- and three-dimensional fixed-path cohesive interfaces under normal, shear, mixed and compressive separation

execution.command: python -m pytest tests/test_interfaces.py tests/test_global_cohesive_residual.py && mpiexec -n 2 python -m pytest tests/test_parallel_cohesive.py
execution.evidence: Material-point envelopes, vector facet resultants, finite-difference tangents, multi-body rank, serial global continuation, MPI force assembly and restart fields are executable regressions.

observables: Normal and tangential jump and traction at every cohesive quadrature point.
Pure Mode-I and Mode-II dissipated fracture energy.
Separation of Mode-II fracture dissipation from residual parallel-penalty stored energy.
Analytical force tangent relative to centered finite difference.
Rigid-body nullity of a three-body, two-interface split model.
Equal axial resultants and zero parasitic shear in a three-dimensional three-layer, two-interface patch.
Serial and two-rank mixed-mode resultants and physical-keyed state fields.
Converged spherical arc-length step through the native bulk-plus-interface residual.
acceptance: The legacy free-slip Mode-I resultant is unchanged.
A precracked degraded-tangential interface carries neither tensile nor shear traction.
Pure-mode complete separation dissipates the declared GIc or GIIc.
A residual tangential penalty preserves GIIc while its independently integrated work remains recoverable stored energy.
Vector and mixed-mode analytical tangents match force derivatives within declared numerical tolerances.
Normal-only connections expose free middle-body modes and full intact connections close the rigid-body rank.
Both interfaces in the three-dimensional three-layer patch transfer the analytical axial resultant without tangential jump or traction.
Two-rank mixed-mode force resultants equal the serial analytical resultant and checkpoint every state field once per physical facet.
limitations: Mixed-mode damage freezes mode mix at initiation and is not a general non-proportional fatigue model.
Friction is a regularized penalty contact option, not a general contact active-set benchmark.
The benchmark is a software verification foundation, not an external structural validation.
